standard.note: Michoacán's plate has a deep maroon band across the top with the state government seal and a QR code, and 'Michoacán – El alma de México' along the bottom.

plates.title: Current design (2022)
plates.fact: Michoacán's plate has a deep maroon band across the top with the state government seal and a QR code, and 'Michoacán – El alma de México' along the bottom.

notes: The current design came with the January 2022 statewide canje under Gov. Ramírez Bedolla. I found no newer design as of 2026; Michoacán sites only cover refrendo and canje requirements. The official photo (michoacan.gob.mx, 5 Jan 2022) shows two truck plates ('Transporte privado camión') with a smaller private-car plate (PNK-758-A, 'Transporte privado automóvil') below. All share the same design, but the photo isn't car-only. I didn't confirm any disability, classic or EV plates. Pre-2022 plates are presumably invalid after the canje, but I didn't confirm that.
